nom: T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel Moisturizing Astringent

avis.titre: One of the things I would want with me if I was stuck on a desert island!
avis.texte: No sting, no alcohol, no bad smell, soothing and pure. This is my go-to face wash and the only thing I have washed my face with since I was 14. I am 70 and witch hazel has taken good care of my facial skin. People tell me how nice my skin is and attribute it to witch hazel - especially this brand. It is my favorite because you can choose between alchohol free or not, because of the scent (or rather the lack of) and the little bit of aloe vera and hyaluronic acid. I use the one with alchohol in the summer when my face is a bit more oily and it gives a clean refreshing feeling. I also mix with a bit of peppermint and tea tree oil in a small spray bottle for a refreshing cooling facial spritz (i started this when my hot flashes started and it is very cooling!) I also like this for cleaning and soothing certain personal areas and for a nice scalp refresher. Sometimes i will mix with a rose essential oil or any other essential oil that has a nice scent and use as a freshening spray when I am at the beach or at a special occasion. Love this stuff and especially this brand! It arrived fast (next day). This is my favorite beauty and personal product - one of the 3 things I would choose to have if i was stuck on a desert island! The soothing properties are a must and it has many uses!

T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel Alcohol Free Moisturizing Astringent is a total skincare gem that exceeded every expectation I had. I have tried countless toners and astringents, and this one stands out immediately. The fact that it is alcohol free makes it gentle yet highly effective. My skin feels refreshed, clean, and hydrated rather than tight or stripped. It soothes irritation instantly, calms redness, and leaves a subtle glow that looks natural and healthy. The liquid is light and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue or sticky feeling. I apply it with a cotton pad or gently pat it in with my hands, and it works beautifully under serums and moisturizers. It has dramatically improved the texture of my skin, minimized the appearance of pores, and helped balance oil in areas that are prone to shine. I also appreciate its versatility. I use it as a toner in the morning and evening, a post-shave soothing agent, and even a gentle refresher during the day. It is lightweight, non-irritating, and the formula feels clean and natural, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. For the price, the quality is exceptional. It delivers results consistently and feels like a spa treatment in a bottle. If you are looking for an effective, gentle, and moisturizing astringent, T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel is a must-have. Five stars without hesitation. It has become an essential part of my skincare routine, and I cannot imagine going without it.

avis.titre: Favorite witch hazel as a sensitive skin personFavorite witch hazel as a sensitive skin person
avis.texte: This is the only with hazel that doesn’t irritate my skin. I’ve been using T.N. Dickinson’s Witch Hazel for a while now, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. It’s gentle on my skin, leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed, and helps remove any leftover dirt or oil after cleansing without making my skin feel overly dry. I also love how versatile it is. I use it as a facial toner, after shaving to help calm my skin, and occasionally on minor skin irritations. It has a natural, clean feel and doesn’t leave behind a sticky residue. My skin feels smoother, refreshed, and balanced after each use. Another thing I appreciate is that it’s made with natural witch hazel and is alcohol-free, so it’s much gentler than many other toners I’ve tried. It’s suitable for daily use and works well even on my sensitive skin. The bottle lasts a long time, making it an excellent value for the money. If you’re looking for a simple, effective, and affordable product to add to your skincare routine, I highly recommend T.N.Dickinson’s Witch Hazel.It’s a dependable product that consistently delivers great results.

avis.titre: Simple ingredients, no unnecessary extras, and exactly what witch hazel should be.
avis.texte: I'm 50 with sensitive skin, and this has become a permanent part of both my morning and evening skincare routines. One of the biggest reasons I keep buying it is the ingredient list. I appreciate that it doesn't have a bunch of unnecessary extras. It's alcohol-free, fragrance-free, and contains ingredients that actually benefit my skin instead of potentially irritating it. I also love that it smells like real witch hazel, not alcohol. If you've ever used those harsh astringents that leave your eyes watering, this is the complete opposite. The scent is clean and natural, and it never leaves my skin feeling tight or stripped. I use it after Pond's Cold Cream, allowing it to dry completely before applying the next step in my routine. It leaves my skin feeling fresh, balanced, and ready for whatever comes next. It's one of those products that quietly does its job every single day without any drama, and I think that's exactly what good skincare should do. This has become a staple in my routine, and I'll continue repurchasing it.

I really like this witch hazel! It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed without leaving behind a heavy or sticky feeling. It’s also fragrance-free and made with 100% natural witch hazel, which I really appreciate. Overall, it’s a great affordable product to keep on hand and I would definitely recommend it!

I’ve been using witch hazel twice a day—once in the morning and once at night—after cleansing my face. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean without any residue. I’ve also used it to calm down breakouts, and it works wonders as a spot treatment. However, I did notice that during colder months, my skin felt slightly drier, so I had to follow up with a good moisturizer. Overall, I highly recommend witch hazel for anyone looking for a natural, affordable, and effective skincare product. It’s especially great for those with oily or combination skin, but even sensitive skin types can benefit if you choose an alcohol-free formula. While it’s not a miracle worker, it’s a reliable addition to any skincare routine. I’d give it a 5 stars.

I wasn’t expecting to fall in love with a bottle of witch hazel, but here we are. I’ve been using T.N. Dickinson’s Witch Hazel for a few weeks now, and my skin has honestly never looked better. I have combination skin that leans oily, and this has been perfect as a toner after cleansing. It removes leftover dirt and oil without making my skin feel tight or dry. It’s also been a lifesaver during breakouts — I dab a little directly on blemishes, and they shrink down way faster than usual. The scent is natural and a bit medicinal (which I actually like — it smells clean and simple, not overly perfumed). I also started using it after shaving and on little bug bites or razor bumps, and it’s so soothing. It’s one of those old-school, multi-use products that actually delivers.
